title: Tomato-Cucumber Salad with Red Onion & Basil
description: A simple summer salad of tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion in a red-wine vinaigrette, finished with fresh basil.

ingredients.name: cherry or grape tomatoes, halved (or 3 medium ripe tomatoes, chopped)
large English cucumber, halved lengthwise and sliced
small red onion, very thinly sliced

instructions.text: Whisk together {4} olive oil, {5} red wine vinegar, {6} Dijon, {7} honey, {8} salt, and {9} black pepper.
Combine {0} tomatoes, {1} cucumber, and {2} red onion in a bowl. Pour the dressing over and toss gently.
Let sit 10–15 minutes so the tomatoes release their juices and mingle with the vinaigrette.
Add {3} basil just before serving and toss again. Taste and adjust with more vinegar, salt, or pepper.

notes: Dill works excellently in place of basil and makes this particularly good alongside seafood and crab cakes. Best eaten the day it's made — the cucumber releases water overnight.
